note: Metadata only. This manifest describes the five runtime artifacts the local demo
requires; it never contains the artifacts themselves, which stay git-ignored.
Paths are relative to the repository root so the manifest is relocatable.
sizes and digests were measured on the accepted artifacts and are recorded here
so the launcher can fail fast (size) or fail hard (SHA-256) before serving.
